# Rodentia
Rodentia are a race of humanoid beings resembling rodents. Resourceful, evasive, sneaky, but fragile.
## Diet
- Can eat raw meat. - Will get poisoned by Theobromine (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and Allicin (Onion, Garlic).
## Benefits
- Uses their claws to do some Slashing and Blunt damage. - Smaller than humans. - Move 5% faster than humans. - Can fit in duffelbags.
## Special
- Can Rummage in disposal chutes, which can dig up trash. - Can "sneak" underneath tables, but not doors.
## Drawbacks
- Takes 30% more Blunt damage, 10% more Slash damage, and 5% more Piercing damage. - Always triggers mousetraps, regardless of whether or not they are wearing shoes. - Gets hungry 33% faster.
